name: Cell–Environment Coupling
description: Fig 4b — cell–environment coupling. The single cell is nested inside the environment (environment ⊃ cells ⊃ cell), and coupling processes wire across that boundary: environmental reaction–diffusion / production–degradation / mechanical stress act on the shared fields, while the cell senses those fields and writes back its uptake and traction — nesting and process coupling together.
